{{Quote|The ASP models are poor conversationalists and they bore me.|2-1B|<ref name="Star Wars: Darth Vader: A 3-D Reconstruction Log">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader: A 3-D Reconstruction Log]]''</ref>}}
'''ASP-series labor droids''', also known as '''Asp droids''', were general-purpose [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] that were found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Labor_droids.png|thumb|left|250px|An [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]
Simple-minded [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the ASPs were strictly working droids and nothing more. Their vocabulary consisted of only "Yes/Affirmative" and "No/Negative". There were over two dozen variants of the Asp droids and the most common of these models was the [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droid]], which stood at 1.6 meters.<ref name="NEGD" /> Because of its low price, this droid was usually known for being an individual's first droid, and was encouraged by its company in hopes that buyers would buy [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromechs]] and [[SE4 servant droid]]s.<ref name="EGD" />

Because of its two word answering system, ''affirmative'' and ''negative'', attempting to gain information from these droids was reported as a maddening game of "guess my secret."<ref name="NEGD" />

==History==
The [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] kept a large number of ASP-7s throughout the settlement, such as [[ASP-704]].

A more advanced model, the [[ASP-19 battle droid/Legends|ASP-19 battle droid]], was used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to hone his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] dueling skills.<ref name="EGD" />
